theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 22 群

items.colloc: completely different 完全不同 | completely satisfied 完全滿意
items.distinct: totally 完全地 | absolutely 絕對地
ex: The report is now completely finished.
這份報告現在已經徹底完成了。
We are completely satisfied with the service.
我們對這項服務感到完全滿意。
The office was completely renovated last month.
辦公室上個月經過了全面翻新。

items.colloc: crowded space 擁擠空間 | crowded street 擁擠街道
items.distinct: congested 阻塞的（交通）| packed 裝滿的
ex: The lobby is very crowded during lunch.
午餐時間大廳非常擁擠。
We avoided the crowded train station today.
我們今天避開了擁擠的火車站。
This area becomes crowded with tourists daily.
這個區域每天都擠滿了遊客。

items.colloc: declare bankruptcy 宣告破產 | declare items 申報物品
items.distinct: announce 公告 | proclaim 公開宣告
ex: Passengers must declare any valuable items.
旅客必須申報任何貴重物品。
The manager will declare the results soon.
經理很快會宣布結果。
They had to declare their assets formally.
他們必須正式申報資產。

items.colloc: decorate the office 裝飾辦公室 | decorate for events 為活動佈置
items.distinct: furnish 配備家具 | renovate 翻新
ex: Staff helped decorate the hall for parties.
員工協助為派對裝飾大廳。
We need to decorate the lobby area.
我們需要裝飾大廳區域。
She will decorate the room with flowers.
她將用鮮花裝飾房間。

items.colloc: business district 商業區 | shopping district 購物區
items.distinct: region 地區（較大）| zone 區域（特定用途）
ex: Our office is in the financial district.
我們的辦公室位於金融區。
Many companies moved to this industrial district.
許多公司搬到了這個工業區。
The local district council held a meeting.
當地的地區委員會舉行了會議。

items.colloc: do not disturb 請勿打擾 | disturb the meeting 干擾會議
items.distinct: bother 煩擾 | interrupt 中斷；打斷
ex: Please do not disturb the working team.
請勿打擾工作中的團隊。
Loud noise can disturb our concentration.
巨大的噪音可能會擾亂我們的注意力。
Sorry to disturb you during the break.
抱歉在休息時間打擾你。

items.pos: v. 開車；推動 | n. 驅動力；車程
items.colloc: drive sales 提升銷售 | drive a car 開車
items.distinct: operate 操作 | steer 駕駛（操縱方向）
ex: New marketing campaigns will drive sales growth.
新的行銷活動將推動銷售成長。
Does he drive to work every morning?
他每天早上都開車去上班嗎？
Innovation remains the drive for our company.
創新依然是我們公司的驅動力。

items.colloc: on duty 值班 | duty free 免稅
items.distinct: responsibility 責任 | task 任務
ex: It is my duty to check reports.
檢查報告是我的職責。
The staff is currently on duty today.
員工今天正在值班。
We need to pay import duty now.
我們現在需要支付進口關稅。

items.colloc: easy access 容易進入 | easy task 簡單任務
items.distinct: simple 簡單的 | effortless 不費力的
ex: The software makes data entry very easy.
這套軟體讓資料輸入變得很容易。
It is easy to find the location.
找到那個地點很容易。
We want an easy way to communicate.
我們想要一種容易溝通的方式。

items.pos: n. 優勢；邊緣 | v. 緩慢移動
items.colloc: competitive edge 競爭優勢 | leading edge 尖端
items.distinct: margin 利潤空間 | border 邊界
ex: Our product has a competitive edge today.
我們的產品目前具有競爭優勢。
She sat on the edge of the chair.
她坐在椅子邊緣。
This company is at the edge of technology.
這家公司處於技術的最尖端。

items.colloc: latest edition 最新版 | special edition 特別版
items.distinct: version 版本（軟體常用）| issue 期刊期數
ex: Please check the latest edition online.
請在線上查閱最新版本。
They published a special edition magazine.
他們發行了一本特別版雜誌。
The first edition sold out very quickly.
第一版很快就售罄了。

items.colloc: elegant design 優雅設計 | elegant solution 優雅的解決方案
items.distinct: graceful 優美的 | sophisticated 精密的
ex: The hotel offers an elegant dining room.
這家飯店提供優雅的用餐空間。
He proposed an elegant solution for us.
他為我們提出了一個精妙的解決方案。
Her presentation style was very elegant.
她的簡報風格非常優雅。

items.colloc: place emphasis on 強調 | major emphasis 主要重點
items.distinct: importance 重要性 | priority 優先順序
ex: Our company places emphasis on customer service.
我們公司強調客戶服務。
The project puts emphasis on cost control.
該專案強調成本控制。
There is a new emphasis on quality.
現在更加強調品質。

items.colloc: encourage employees 鼓勵員工 | encourage growth 促進成長
items.distinct: urge 力勸 | support 支持
ex: Managers should encourage team communication daily.
經理應該每天鼓勵團隊溝通。
We encourage staff to share new ideas.
我們鼓勵員工分享新點子。
The policy is meant to encourage investment.
這項政策旨在促進投資。

items.colloc: ensure safety 確保安全 | ensure success 確保成功
items.distinct: assure 向人保證 | insure 投保
ex: Please ensure that all files are saved.
請確保所有檔案都已儲存。
We must ensure the delivery arrives soon.
我們必須確保貨物儘快送達。
Strict tests ensure the product quality.
嚴格的測試確保了產品品質。

items.colloc: establish a business 創業 | establish contact 建立聯繫
items.distinct: found 創立（組織）| set up 設立
ex: They want to establish a new office.
他們想要建立一個新的辦公室。
We hope to establish good business ties.
我們希望建立良好的業務關係。
Rules were established to improve efficiency.
為了提升效率，規定已建立起來。

items.colloc: medical examination 健康檢查 | careful examination 仔細審查
items.distinct: test 測試 | inspection 視察；檢驗
ex: The final examination is scheduled for June.
期末考試定於六月舉行。
A thorough examination reveals no major errors.
詳細審查後未發現重大錯誤。
She went for her annual medical examination.
她去做了年度健康檢查。

items.pos: n. 特色；特徵 | v. 以…為特色
items.colloc: key feature 主要特色 | advanced feature 進階功能
items.distinct: characteristic 特性 | aspect 層面
ex: This new model has many useful features.
這款新機型有許多實用的功能。
The magazine will feature the CEO today.
這本雜誌今天將專題報導執行長。
Safety is a key feature of cars.
安全性是汽車的一項關鍵特色。

items.pos: n. 預測；預報 | v. 預測
items.colloc: sales forecast 銷售預測 | weather forecast 天氣預報
items.distinct: prediction 預言 | projection 推算
ex: The sales forecast for next year looks.
明年的銷售預測看起來不錯。
Experts forecast a rise in market demand.
專家預測市場需求將會上升。
Did you check the weather forecast today?
你今天看天氣預報了嗎？

items.pos: adv. 向前 | v. 轉寄 | adj. 前方的
items.colloc: look forward to 期待 | forward an email 轉寄郵件
items.distinct: ahead 向前（空間/時間）| advance 前進
ex: Please forward the message to the team.
請將這封訊息轉寄給團隊。
We look forward to meeting you soon.
我們期待很快與您見面。
The company is moving forward with plans.
公司正向前推動各項計畫。
